August 1, 2025

# Orders query now supports `current_total_price` and `total_weight` filters and `CURRENT_TOTAL_PRICE` as a `sortKey`

DateAugust 1, 2025

Version[2025-10](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-10)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

The [orders](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/queries/orders) `query` argument now supports the `current_total_price` ([documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/queries/orders#argument-query-filter-current_total_price)) and `total_weight` ([documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/queries/orders#argument-query-filter-total_weight)) filters. Additionally, we've introduced the ability to use `sortKey` with `CURRENT_TOTAL_PRICE` ([documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/queries/orders#arguments-sortKey.enums.CURRENT_TOTAL_PRICE)).
